Container.Name: Find My Timeline
Container.Overview: Self-hosted Apple Find My location history for Unraid with a responsive dashboard, interactive route map, device cards, exact date and time filtering, chronological timeline, local SQLite storage and optional protected Apple two-factor re-authentication.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: Apple Find My location history timeline iCloud tracking map GPS responsive dashboard mobile
Container.Requires: Apple ID with two-factor authentication and internet access. The WebUI exposes sensitive location history and must not be published directly to the internet. Use a trusted network, VPN or authenticated HTTPS reverse proxy.
Container.Changes: Version 0.2.0. Validated on Unraid OS 7.3.2 with the public GHCR image, persistent database and Apple session volumes, WebUI, health check, device polling and Apple two-factor authentication. Adds versioned Docker tags and automated GitHub releases.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: HTTP port for the responsive WebUI. Do not expose directly to the internet.

Config.Name: Database
Config.Description: Persistent SQLite database directory containing sensitive location history.

Config.Name: Apple Session
Config.Description: Persistent Apple session, cookies and authentication timestamp metadata.

Config.Name: Enable WebUI authentication flow
Config.Description: Allow Apple re-authentication from the WebUI. Requires a WebUI administrator password and protected network access.

Config.Name: WebUI administrator password
Config.Description: Long unique password protecting Apple authentication endpoints. This does not protect access to the location map itself.

Config.Name: Estimated session lifetime
Config.Description: Estimated Apple session lifetime in days used for the countdown. Apple may expire sessions earlier.

Config.Name: Authentication flow timeout
Config.Description: Maximum seconds between starting Apple authentication and entering the verification code.

Config.Name: Apple ID password
Config.Description: Optional. Leaving this unset avoids storing the Apple ID password in the container configuration.

Config.Name: Minimum polling interval
Config.Description: Minimum number of minutes between location requests.

Config.Name: Maximum polling interval
Config.Description: Maximum number of minutes between location requests.

Config.Name: Web host
Config.Description: Web server binding inside the container.
